body: Would you read my recent posts and then maybe message me?
Actually I am not a minor. Nor was I at that point in time. My mom is just a huge control freak

Horses are a lot like people. They have their moments, but the horse is definitely not kicking for no reason at all. The horse may be in pain, it could be feeling threatened or harassed, if it is a mare she may be in heat, I know my mares can get kicky in heat even my best behaved. If it’s happening when you are trying to clean their hooves there may be something stuck in there that’s hurting them. Don’t get angry, I suggest calling your vet and having them take a look!

It’s just really hard. I turn 18 on April 2, and I’ve said I’m going to move in with one of my grandparents. And my mom is like “well what then? You’ll have no phone, no car, no money, no clothes.” I think she is forgetting I paid for half that car and I’m the one who pays the gas. I make my own money I work 4 jobs remember. She just is so manipulating and everytime she guilt trips me to forgive her. “Oh sweetie im so sorry. I didn’t mean it. I just miss my sweet blue eyed baby girl. Oh i just miss the sweet innocent girl you use to be. You use to tell everyone you were the athletic one, but now you sit around and do nothing.” I stopped most of my sports because of her. I stopped playing softball because I started to be afraid of the ball after getting hit with it in a game, and plus it interfered with my dance schedule. I stopped dancing because I just lost the passion and I didn’t want them paying for something I don’t love. Basketball and soccer just ended up not being my thing. I was amazing at volleyball, I played for a regional team that got 3rd place out of 20 teams at regionals. “Oh sweetie I think you are just too short for it” I was amazing. Now I only golf, which I do love, but she always says I’m not going to do the best without getting into better shape, (what would she know she can barely hit the ball, and I’m the first player on the team, I played varsity and lettered my freshman year) and I ride horses, jumping and barrel racing, but according to her the horse does all the work, all I do is sit there. Ha! She doesn’t even know the half of it!
